question: Explain why no work is done in moving a charge from one point to another on an equipotential surface. Give reason.

options.A: No work is done, since $W=q\Delta V=0$ for two points on the same equipotential surface
options.B: Work done is $qV$ because potential is the same everywhere
options.C: Work done depends on the distance between the points, even when $\Delta V=0$
options.D: Work done is maximum because electric field is perpendicular to the surface
